content.text:
**Finding: missing (INSURANCE)** — submitted.

The Agreement has no insurance covenant at all. The only "insurance"-family hits are Net Sales deductions (p0101, p0102) and "insurrection" in force majeure (p0763). Article 16 gives reciprocal indemnities, a consequential-damages disclaimer and recall allocation, but nothing requiring Array — which manufactures and supplies Product, sponsors Clinical Studies and holds our Confidential Information — to carry coverage backing those indemnities. Article 18 General Provisions is likewise silent, so the position falls below even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).

Redline (validated, ok:true): a new Section 18.15 inserted after 18.14 in General Provisions, at the preferred limits (CGL 1M/2M including product liability, E&O 2M, cyber 5M where Array processes our data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). The comment offers the fallback limits or, alternatively, confirmation that equivalent coverage sits in the Quality/Supply Agreements referenced at 18.7 — a common allocation in pharma licences.
